name: CCDN_training_dataset
description:
It's the training dataset for CCDN: Checkerboard Corner Detection Network for Robust Camera Calibration (ICIRA 2018 oral)
Here is its pdf of public version.
As a side note, If you are interested in the checkerboard corner detection with deep learning.
You can see the follow-up paper of this article Automatic checkerboard detection for camera calibration (ICME 2021 oral)
If you use this dataset, please cite our two articles. Thanks.
reputation: Niche dataset published by the authors for checkerboard corner detection and camera calibration research; limited but relevant adoption in calibration/vision subcommunities.
